notes.title: The Cooking Club Demo – Coming October 2nd! 🍳✨
notes.content:
Originally, we aimed for a 6th October 2025 release, but due to Steam’s requirement that demos are available by the 3rd, we’ve decided to move things forward.

🗓 New Release Date: 2nd October 2025
🕛 Time: Midnight (BST)


What’s included in the demo?

A short prologue introducing the world of The Cooking Club

Meet the girls for the very first time

A setup that leads directly into Chapter One

For those curious, the demo contains:

591 dialogue blocks

Roughly 6,641 words

About 36,550 characters

We can’t wait for you to get your first taste of The Cooking Club and share your thoughts with us. 💕

notes.title: Check Out The Cooking Club's New Redesign!
notes.content:
Hey Chefs!
We've been busy cooking up a storm over here for The Cooking Club and preparing a wave wave of awesome stuff to show you all.. and we can finally begin doing that! Last night on the 18th of September 2025, we hosted New Game+ 2025 which is our in house game studio showcase! We had guests like Blue Tango Street.. Studio Maroo.. and even twitch streamer and affiliate Clunia join us!



So here we are.. and we don't want to waste anymore time.. so without further ado.. check out the trailer below alongside some new cover art (which you saw on this blog post) AND an updated "look" at the girls' via their "info cards" which can be found on our Steam Page.
Happy Cooking!

- Studio Z
